name: single-file-edit
prompt: In scripts/qa/mcp-live.ts, change the WAIT_MS constant from 30_000 to 45_000. Do not change any other lines.
success_criteria: `git diff --numstat` lists exactly scripts/qa/mcp-live.ts with 1 line added and 1 deleted, and the added line is `const WAIT_MS = 45_000;`. No other file changed and no comment was added. `bun x tsc --noEmit -p tsconfig.runtime.json` exits 0.
